component.name: ShotCraft
component.summary: Capture, annotate, redact and share screenshots

description.p: ShotCraft captures an area, a window, the whole screen or a scrolling page, then lets you annotate, redact and share the result.

ul.li: Area, window, fullscreen, scrolling and self-timer captures over a frozen screen
Arrows, shapes, text, counters, highlighter, spotlight, blur and pixelate
Backgrounds with padding, rounded corners and shadows
On-device text recognition and QR code reading
Pinned screenshots, capture history and drag and drop into other apps
Every capture mode is a command you can bind to a keyboard shortcut
